axis_gap_map.why_highest_value: Every one of the ~23 covered axes reasons about MOLECULES (solvent, cured-network, or surface chemistry). None reasons about the PIGMENTED FILM. For a marine anti-corrosion coating the single governing barrier/mechanical parameter is CPVC: below it the film is a continuous barrier; above it interstitial voids open and water/O2 permeability, blistering and under-film corrosion rise sharply (reduced PVC Lambda=PVC/CPVC). Opening this layer is the highest-value un-touched gap in the portfolio.

directional_physics_reproduced: dense equiaxed extender barytes -> HIGH CPVC (~0.68): packs efficiently (correct)
high-structure laminar talc/mica -> LOW CPVC (~0.40-0.45): poor packing (correct)
anticorrosive zinc_phosphate CPVC ~0.52 -> formulate PVC<CPVC for barrier (actionable)

packing_bounds_falsification_KPI.interpretation: Every equiaxed/nodular pigment's parameter-free CPVC lands inside the geometrically-permissible packing band [0.44, 0.7405] (lower=cohesive random-loose, upper=ordered close packing pi/(3root2)). A value outside (e.g. 0.9 or 0.2) is impossible as a packing fraction and would FALSIFY the Asbeck-Van Loo packing premise. It does not. Non-circular: the bounds are pure sphere-packing geometry and use ZERO external CPVC data. Note the platy laminar pigments (mica 0.375, talc 0.447) fall at/below the equiaxed floor -- the engine correctly reflects anisotropic platy packing, so the equiaxed-band test is applied only to equiaxed/nodular habits.

tio2_magnitude_anchor.note: Treated rutile grade (OA~24) -> engine 0.487, inside the textbook density-method CPVC band 0.45-0.50. Single independent magnitude anchor.
